page_label: 说　明　书 11/17 页

paragraphs.zh: 向反应釜中加入100mL三氟乙醇，开动搅拌，室温下投入5.5g金属钾(99％，0.14mol)，搅拌至溶解完全，经脱溶后得到三氟乙醇醇钾固体，密封备用。
paragraphs.en: Add 100mL of trifluoroethanol into the reaction kettle, start stirring, and at room temperature charge 5.5g of potassium metal (99％, 0.14mol); stir until completely dissolved, and after desolvation obtain solid potassium trifluoroethoxide, seal and set aside for use.
paragraphs.notes: 三氟乙醇醇钾 is literally 'trifluoroethanol potassium alcoholate', i.e. potassium 2,2,2-trifluoroethoxide.

paragraphs.zh: 向三氟乙醇醇钾中加入130mL乙腈，搅拌溶解后控制釜温在15℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钾盐(98.0％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为1h，加毕保温反应6h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至3，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物32.6g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为98.2％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率91.9％。
paragraphs.en: Add 130mL of acetonitrile to the potassium trifluoroethoxide; after stirring to dissolve, control the kettle temperature at 15℃, and add the potassium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate prepared in step (1) (98.0％, 0.1mol) into the reaction flask in eight portions, the total addition time being 1h; once addition is complete hold the temperature and react for 6h. When the reaction is finished, desolvate under negative pressure, add 120mL of water to the kettle residue, and after stirring to dissolve add concentrated hydrochloric acid dropwise to acidify the system pH to 3; then filter, rinse with water and dry to obtain 32.6g of product. HPLC quantification gives the content of the target compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid as 98.2％, a two-step reaction yield of 91.9％ calculated on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate.
paragraphs.notes: The text calls the substrate the potassium salt (钾盐); the scheme at [0121] draws it as the sodium carboxylate. See discrepancies. The product name 2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸 is written without brackets around the whole (trifluoroethoxy)methyl group, so it reads literally as '(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl' at C3, which is what the drawing shows.

paragraphs.zh: (1)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐的制备，主要反应过程可以以如下反应方程式表示：
paragraphs.en: (1) Preparation of the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:
paragraphs.notes: 苯甲酸盐 names only 'benzoate salt' without saying which cation; the drawing at [0126] makes it the sodium salt.

paragraphs.zh: 向反应瓶中加入2-甲基-2-戊醇200mL，开动搅拌，室温下将4.2g氢化钠(60％，0.105mol)滴入其中，待氢化钠溶解完全后，控制釜温在25℃，将34.8g2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应，反应过程微微放热，控制釜温为25℃，反应6h。反应结束，液相色谱中控2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐归一含量为97.8％，负压脱尽溶剂直接用于后续醚化反应。
paragraphs.en: Add 200mL of 2-methyl-2-pentanol into the reaction flask, start stirring, and at room temperature drip 4.2g of sodium hydride (60％, 0.105mol) into it; after the sodium hydride has dissolved completely, control the kettle temperature at 25℃ and pour 34.8g of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate (98％, 0.1mol) into the kettle to carry out the alkaline cleavage reaction. The reaction process is slightly exothermic; control the kettle temperature at 25℃ and react for 6h. At the end of the reaction, in-process liquid chromatography gives a normalised content of sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate of 97.8％; strip the solvent off completely under negative pressure and use the product directly in the subsequent etherification reaction.
paragraphs.notes: Translated literally in two places. 滴入 ('drip in') is used of 60％ sodium hydride, which is a solid dispersion, not a liquid. 碱解反应 is literally 'alkaline decomposition/hydrolysis reaction' while the drawn transformation is methyl ester to sodium carboxylate; no reading is imposed here.

paragraphs.zh: (2)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备，主要反应过程可以以如下反应方程式表示：
paragraphs.en: (2) Preparation of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:

paragraphs.zh: 向反应釜中加入200mL DMF、11.6g三氟乙醇(99％，0.115mol)和5.4g氢氧化钠(96％，0.13mol)，开动搅拌，控制釜温在5℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(97.8％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为3h，加毕保温反应6h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至3，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物32.4g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为96.5％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率89.7％。
paragraphs.en: Add 200mL of DMF, 11.6g of trifluoroethanol (99％, 0.115mol) and 5.4g of sodium hydroxide (96％, 0.13mol) into the reaction kettle, start stirring, control the kettle temperature at 5℃, and add the sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate prepared in step (1) (97.8％, 0.1mol) into the reaction flask in eight portions, the total addition time being 3h; once addition is complete hold the temperature and react for 6h. When the reaction is finished, desolvate under negative pressure, add 120mL of water to the kettle residue, and after stirring to dissolve add concentrated hydrochloric acid dropwise to acidify the system pH to 3; then filter, rinse with water and dry to obtain 32.4g of product. HPLC quantification gives the content of the target compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid as 96.5％, a two-step reaction yield of 89.7％ calculated on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate.
paragraphs.notes: The image sets a wide justification gap between 200mL and DMF; the text layer carries two spaces there. Recorded as a single space.
